notes.text: Available from cPanel & WHM 11.122. This function returns Sitejet Commerce data.
Pinned CLI and URL examples use Sitejet/get_commerce, while the formal path and metadata.command example are bare. The canonical API-map identity is retained.
PR64 review 5721097744 reports bare get_commerce failing and Sitejet/get_commerce succeeding by GET on 11.138.0.19, with string is_enabled and null storeurl. This is separate reviewer evidence.

This no-argument read uses GET; the pinned source lacks x-readonly. Preserve integer 0|1 and exact string is_enabled values, including empty strings, and nullable storeurl. Returned URLs are payload data and are never fetched.

notes.text: Available from cPanel & WHM 11.122. This function enables Sitejet Commerce for all users and allows the hosting provider to set a custom URL for their payment platform, which customers can use to purchase the Sitejet Commerce upgrade.
Pinned CLI and URL examples use Sitejet/set_commerce, while the formal path and metadata.command example are bare. Omitted storeurl retains the documented Sitejet Commerce store default.

Use the source-backed Sitejet/set_commerce route with form POST; no successful live set call is established. Explicit false sends allowCommerce=0. Treat supplied storefront URLs as sensitive, encode them once and never fetch them. The client makes one request without retry or rollback.
The pinned response documents metadata only and no data payload; this method returns void. Inspect responseMeta() for the WHM outcome.

Formal path and metadata.command remain bare. Use form POST for configuration changes; this route is source-backed and has not been live-observed.

notes.text: Available from cPanel & WHM 62. This function validates a login token with the cPanel Store or a cPanel Market provider, and then returns access tokens.

Login-token and redirect-URL inputs and returned tokens are treated as sensitive. Returned access_token and refresh_token strings remain optional inside the optional payload list. The client does not follow URLs or retry token validation. The bare validate_login_token route follows the pinned path and both samples; the Market- operationId is not a wire namespace.

evidence.note: Pinned whm.openapi.json.gz SHA-256 6edb13c51d53f3c2be1fa83cc93e31d3a81f4f8506b3b45284fa00b986041594. /validate_login_token/get has operationId Market-validate_login_token, but formal path, CLI and URL samples consistently use bare validate_login_token. Keep that route; no token call or live success is established.

description: Sitejet Commerce configuration and cPanel Store or Market login-token validation.
